summary: The post-integration ordering and red-path push block are correct, and focused tests pass. Two findings remain.

review.title: Non-UTF-8 consumer script violates the promised no-op guard
review.finding: recheck_local_gates catches only OSError around read_text(encoding=utf-8). An unrelated scripts/verify_local.py with non-UTF-8 bytes raises UnicodeDecodeError instead of remaining a no-op, contradicting AC-1 and the F11 documentation. Catch UnicodeError alongside OSError and add a focused test for both an unmarked script and an undecodable script.

review.title: Mini-plan contradicts the implemented delivery-refresh change
review.finding: The plan says do not alter the delivery ladder and describes only the static F11 wiring test, but the accepted implementation correctly changes pr_delivery_host.refresh_branch and adds runtime tests. Update the mini-plan so the committed planning evidence describes the actual implementation.
